summary: Focana 2.4.8 keeps focused steps separate from their parent tasks when you mark work complete.
improvements: Completion controls now clearly say whether they will complete the focused step or the full task across full, compact, and floating views.
The focused-step confirmation explains that the main task and other steps will stay open.
fixes: Completing a focused subtask now completes only that step instead of completing the parent task and every sibling subtask.
The active focus timer now continues after a focused step is completed, preserving the rest of the task plan.
